CrossnoKaye | Sr. Software Engineer in Test | REMOTE (US)

Hi HN! CrossnoKaye is a Series C startup tackling climate change by transforming the heavy industrial sector. Our platform uses real-time optimization, advanced modeling, and modern cloud infrastructure to deliver 40% average energy savings and megaton-scale emissions cuts across industrial facilities. https://crossnokaye.com/

We’re hiring for a Sr. Software Engineer in Test to join our Platform team. We’re looking for a hands-on engineer who loves Golang, backend frameworks, and automated testing. You’ll play a key role in shaping the architecture, testability, and quality of our platform. This is a hands-on senior IC role with strong ownership. Must have strong proficiency in Go.

Interested? Email our team: careers@crossnokaye.com -- Please include a resume and the title of the role within the subject line.

Thank you & I look forward to hearing from you!
